summary.text: Charles Perry is a Republican member of the Texas State Senate who has represented District 28 since September 2014 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. A certified public accountant and land developer, he previously served in the Texas House of Representatives.

paragraphs.text: Charles Perry graduated from Sweetwater High School in 1980 and earned a B.B.A. from Texas Tech in 1984, according to Ballotpedia.
His professional experience includes work as a CPA who owns a small firm, Charles Perry PC, and as a land developer with Path, LLC.
Perry represented District 83 in the Texas House of Representatives from 2011 to 2014 and assumed office in the State Senate on September 30, 2014.
In 2023-2024 he was assigned to the Finance, Special Committee on Redistricting, Senate State Affairs and Senate Transportation committees, as well as the Committee of the Whole Senate.
He advanced from the Republican primary on March 3, 2026.
